mainEntity.name: Do I need the 60-hour or the 20-hour course?

acceptedAnswer.text: New preparers registering with CTEC for the first time take the 60-hour qualifying course. Registered preparers take 20 hours of continuing education every year to renew.
October 31 each year. Late renewal runs through January 15 with a late fee. After that your registration lapses and you must retake the 60-hour course.

mainEntity.name: Do I report my own hours to CTEC?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your provider reports completions to CTEC. Timing varies by provider, so ask the school how soon it reports before you enroll.

mainEntity.name: Are IRS AFSP hours the same as CTEC hours?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, though many providers bundle them. CTEC requires California-specific hours the IRS program does not.

mainEntity.name: What is the best CTEC course?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best CTEC course is the one that fits how you learn and what you need: the price, whether you want self-paced online study or live classes, a printed book, PDF or online videos, the support available, and how quickly the school reports your hours to CTEC. Tax Course Finder lists every CTEC-approved provider side by side so you can filter by those features, compare current prices and coupon codes, and go straight to the school’s course page to enroll.
Provider websites and provider-submitted pricing, checked weekly. Coupon prices are calculated from the listed code and verified before publication.

mainEntity.name: What does the Verified badge mean?

acceptedAnswer.text: An authorized representative has claimed the profile and confirmed its pricing, courses and policies. It is about accuracy, not endorsement.

mainEntity.name: We never signed up. Why are we listed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every CTEC-approved provider is included so students see the whole market. Basic listings are free, and correcting factual errors is always free.

mainEntity.name: How do we fix incorrect information?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use Request a Correction, or email providers@taxcoursefinder.com with the page, what is wrong, the correct information, and a source.
